thread:
leah_people_ops: Quick proposal to smooth reviewer load for the mid-cycle window: sampling + staggered deadlines. Need fast sign-off so reminders go out this week.

maria_manager_rye: Sounds promising. How do you pick who is in the early sample?

leah_people_ops: Early sample = 20%: customer-facing ICs, recent launches, or people with major metrics. Baseline = 50%. Edge/cross-team = 30%.

leah_people_ops: Staggered deadlines: 60% of each manager's queue due Day 3, remaining 40% due Day 7. Manager handback SLA stays 5 business days.

toni_engineering_manager: Can we protect an APAC-friendly calibration slot?

leah_people_ops: Yes Signal Check runs twice (08:00 PST and 18:00 PST). Consensus session on Day 8.

simon_recruiter: Note: hiring surge mid-June -- new hires get excluded from early sample. I'll DM start dates.

leah_people_ops: Perfect. Ops will spot-check 10 random reviews per manager before calibration. Ops-bot will send reminders Day 2, Day 6, and final day.

dan_platform_eng: OK from infra side. Opt-in for teams that want everything earlier?

leah_people_ops: Yes, managers can opt in; we'll tag them as "accelerated" in the sheet.

ops-bot: Reminder configured: reviewer reminders Day 2/Day 6/Final. Calendar invites queued.

leah_people_ops: If no objections by EOD today I'll lock and publish the opt-in. :white_check_mark:
